newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: PRESS DIGEST - Sri Lanka Newspapers - July 1.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Sri Lanka Newspapers - July 1.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Sri Lankan press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
Fifteen Liberation Tigers of Tamil Eelam (LTTE) leaders, including their top doctor, were killed when the Sri Lankan navy sank a rebel flotilla on Saturday, security sources said.

The Colombo High Court to give verdict on Tuesday in a criminal defemation case against editor of the Sunday Times newspaper, Sinha Ratnatunga. The case has been brought against Ratnatunga by President Chandrika Bandaranaike Kumaratunga.
LTTE is abducting refugees from camps in the east and forcing them to give blood needed to treat rebels wounded in recent clashes with the Sri Lanka army, security sources said.

Government Agent for the northern Jaffna district recalled to Colombo with immediate effect, say senior government sources. Officials say the decision could be due to allegations of mismanagement of foodstuffs and other materials being sent to the former rebel stronghold of Jaffna.
Five LTTE rebels who tried to escape Saturday night's navy assault by swimming ashore, captured by security forces.
